# LiveKit telemetry conventions

Schema: `https://livekit.io/schemas/telemetry/0.2.0`. Upstream OTel keys (OTel semconv v1.44.0) are referenced, not listed here.

| `lk.device.app_state` | enum: `foreground`, `background` | client | none |  | Whether the app is in front of the user. All platforms; the web maps page visibility. |

## Events

### `custom`

Namespace of app-defined events. The core emits `custom.<name>` with the app's own attributes. The `custom.` prefix keeps app events from colliding with or spoofing `lk.*` events. An app's attributes, on its events and on the session (correlation attributes such as `app.call_id`), may not use the reserved keys, and stay within the limits; anything else is rejected, never truncated, and counted in `lk.telemetry.dropped.invalid`. An event's own attributes override the session's.

### `lk.device.app_state.changed`

The app moved to the foreground or background. Sent once with the initial state, then on each change. All platforms.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.app_state` | required |

### `lk.device.audio.interruption`

An audio session interruption began or ended. iOS; Android from audio focus loss and gain. Not sent by the JS port.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.audio.interruption` | required |

### `lk.device.audio_route.changed`

The audio route changed. iOS; Android from its audio device callbacks; optional elsewhere. Not sent by the JS port.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.audio_route.outputs` | required |
| `lk.device.audio_route.reason` | required |

### `lk.device.battery.changed`

Charging changed, or the level crossed 20 % or 10 % unplugged. Never per percent; silent where the level is unknown. iOS and Android; not sent by the JS port.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.battery.charging` | required |
| `lk.device.battery.level` | required |

A capture device failed. All platforms.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.capture.device` | required |
| `lk.device.capture.reason` | required |

Low Power Mode changed. Sent once with the initial reading, then on each change; never where the platform has no source.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.low_power.enabled` | required |

### `lk.device.memory.changed`

Memory pressure changed. Sent once with the initial reading, then on each change.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.memory.pressure` | required |

### `lk.device.network.changed`

The network path changed. Sent once with the initial state, then when any of its attributes changes. iOS, macOS and Android; on the web, Chromium only.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.network.constrained` | required |
| `lk.device.network.expensive` | required |
| `network.connection.type` | required |

### `lk.device.thermal.changed`

Thermal state changed. Sent once with the initial reading, then on each change. A platform without a thermal source sends none. A device event: a record of the process, not of a room session.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.device.thermal.state` | required |

### `lk.ping`

Pipeline smoke test. Never emitted in production paths. Not sent by the JS port.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.ping.seq` | recommended |

### `lk.room.disconnected`

The Room left connected for good. Once per session, never on a reconnect. INFO when the client hung up (`client_initiated`), WARN otherwise.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.disconnect.reason` | required |

### `lk.rtc.stats.sample`

One RTC stats window for one track and direction. One per track and direction per window, timestamped at the window's end, also closed early when the track ends, at disconnect and at shutdown. Keyed by session and track: two rooms receiving the same track send two windows. Only the track, kind, direction, window and sample count are always present; counters and gauges a platform or direction lacks are omitted.

### `lk.telemetry.report`

Self-telemetry; counts since the previous report. Sent after a loss, failure, refusal, capped hold or disk error, and once at shutdown as the session summary, so fleet-wide success rates have denominators. A record of the process, not of a room session. Losses by policy (a project that receives nothing, the opt-out) are never reported.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `lk.telemetry.cache.batches` | required |
| `lk.telemetry.cache.delete_errors` | conditionally_required: When non-zero (JS port only). |
| `lk.telemetry.cache.list_errors` | conditionally_required: When non-zero (JS port only). |
| `lk.telemetry.cache.read_errors` | conditionally_required: When non-zero (JS port only). |
| `lk.telemetry.cache.write_errors` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.dropped.cache_error` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |

| `lk.telemetry.dropped.corrupt` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.dropped.expired` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.dropped.invalid` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.dropped.oversized` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.dropped.queue_full` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |

| `lk.telemetry.holds.capped` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.uploads.bytes` | required |
| `lk.telemetry.uploads.failed` | required |
| `lk.telemetry.uploads.sent` | required |
| `lk.telemetry.uploads.timeouts` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |
| `lk.telemetry.uploads.unauthorized` | conditionally_required: When non-zero. |

## Spans

### `lk.connect` (client)

One connect attempt. Dashboards compute connect phases only from the required checkpoints, which every platform sends in this order; best-effort ones refine a platform's own view and may be missing or ordered differently.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: Only when `lk.outcome` is `error` and the failure has a type. |
| `lk.connect.attempt` | required |
| `lk.outcome` | required |

### `lk.publish` (internal)

One track publish. A child of the ambient span when there is one; a publish before the connect completes (a microphone published early) is its own span in the session's trace.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: Only when `lk.outcome` is `error` and the failure has a type. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.track.kind` | required |
| `lk.track.source` | required |
| `lk.track_sid` | conditionally_required: On success; the server assigns it. |

### `lk.reconnect` (client)

One reconnect cycle. `cancelled` when `disconnect()` or a newer reconnect wins. Each attempt is a checkpoint named `attempt <n> <mode>`: a dynamic name (the Notion conventions keep dynamic data out of names; open decision), mirrored by `lk.reconnect.attempts` and `lk.reconnect.mode`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: Only when `lk.outcome` is `error` and the failure has a type. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.reconnect.attempts` | conditionally_required: After the first attempt. |
| `lk.reconnect.mode` | conditionally_required: After the first attempt. |
| `lk.reconnect.reason` | required |

### `lk.subscribe` (internal)

One subscription, from the intent to subscribe to the first media. Starts when the intent exists: a remote publish under autoSubscribe, a manual subscribe, or, for tracks already in the room, the join. Ends `ok` at the first inbound stats reading with bytes; `cancelled` on unsubscribe or unpublish before media; `error` on a subscription failure, or with `error.type = timed_out` when no media came within 30 s, also through a later disconnect. The core owns the span; an SDK only reports the remote track's lifecycle.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `error.type` | conditionally_required: Only when `lk.outcome` is `error` and the failure has a type. |
| `lk.outcome` | required |
| `lk.pii.remote_participant_identity` | recommended |
| `lk.track.kind` | required |
| `lk.track.source` | required |
| `lk.track_sid` | required |

| `code.function.name` | recommended |
| `code.line.number` | recommended |
| `lk.log.logger` | required |

### `livekit.client.record`

| `lk.room_sid` | conditionally_required: Once the client has joined the room. |
| `otel.event.name` | conditionally_required: On event records; duplicates the record's `event_name`. |
